Resolves #20275

Adds `Neo.collection.Sorter.getValue(item, property)` to resolve dotted property paths on `Neo.data.Record` instances and plain objects, lifts `sortArray(arr)` into `Neo.collection.Base` (eliminating the duplicate `Neo.data.TreeStore#sortArray`), and updates `Neo.data.Store#resolveField` so Turbo Mode (`autoInitRecords: false`) soft-hydrates complex root fields of dotted paths without stamping flat keys onto raw items.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright Chromium unit suite covering AC-1..AC-4) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` (`Neo.collection.Sorter.getValue resolves flat keys, Symbol keys, and dotted paths on Records and plain objects`; `Neo.collection.Base sorts plain objects by dotted property paths with useTransformValue true/false and custom sortBy`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` (`Neo.data.Store sorts Records and Turbo Mode raw objects by dotted paths without stamping flat keys, and resets via sort()`; `Neo.data.TreeStore inherits sortArray from Collection and sorts hierarchical levels by dotted paths and index in Record and Turbo Mode`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` (`Neo.data.TreeStore inherits sortArray from Collection and sorts hierarchical levels by dotted paths and index in Record and Turbo Mode`) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` (4 unit tests covering `Sorter.getValue`, `Collection`, `Store`, and `TreeStore` in Record and Turbo modes; 275/275 `collection/` and `data/` unit tests pass) |

## Deltas from ticket
1. **`Collection#doSort` in-place sort + `me._items = items` assignment:** `doSort(items=this._items, silent=false)` sorts `items` in place via `me.sortArray(items)` without an extra `items.slice()` allocation (`previousItems = items.slice()` is already captured before sorting), and retains `me._items = items` because `Collection#filter()` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:894`) calls `me.doSort(me.items, true)`, where `me.items` has `clone: 'shallow'` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:85-89`) and returns a shallow copy rather than `me._items` (`test/playwright/unit/collection/Base.spec.mjs:194`).
2. **Test file placement:** All four unit test arms (`Sorter.getValue`, `Collection`, `Store`, and `TreeStore` in Record + Turbo Mode) are consolidated in `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` (and `#20275` AC-4 is updated to match).

## Commits
- `59e702372f` — initial `Sorter.getValue`, `Collection#sortArray`, `Store#resolveField` dotted-path support, and unit suite.
- `85a57d5915` — adds `TreeStore` Record-mode (`autoInitRecords: true`) test arm (`RA-1`), removes redundant `items.slice()` in `Collection#doSort` while documenting `filter()`'s `me.items` shallow-clone assignment (`RA-2`), and documents the duck-typing boundary in `Sorter.getValue` JSDoc.

## Evolution
Round 1 review from `@neo-opus-ada` (`PRR_kwDODSospM8AAAABWDGUCA`) caught that `AC-2` claimed `TreeStore` coverage in both modes while only Turbo Mode was tested (`RA-1`), that `Collection#doSort` had an extra `items.slice()` copy before `sortArray` and the PR body's `## AC Evidence` table missed its header row and `AC-2` mapping (`RA-2`), and requested a Contract Ledger on `#20275` (`RA-3`). Probing `RA-2` against `collection/Base.spec.mjs` also surfaced why `me._items = items` after `me.sortArray(items)` is load-bearing when `Collection#filter()` passes `me.items` (`clone: 'shallow'`).

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None — all ACs are covered in unit CI (`test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs`).

*   **Expected Solution Shape:** One value resolver: a direct read first, then a dotted fallback only when the value is `undefined`. *   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `Sorter.getValue` is the resolver and duck-types `get`, which keeps `collection/` free of `data/`. `Collection#sortArray` serves `doSort` and TreeStore. `resolveField` hydrates the declared root and returns `Neo.ns(...)` without stamping. ### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** `Sorter.getValue` calls `item.get(property)` on any item whose `get` is a function, not only Records. A `Collection` holding Neo collections or `Map`s gets `get('a.b')` before the `Neo.ns` fallback. That is benign for both today, since they return `undefined` and fall through, but a `get` that throws would surface mid-sort. Duck typing is the right trade against importing `RecordFactory` into `collection/`. A JSDoc sentence naming that boundary would let the next reader keep it on purpose. Non-blocking.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit (per guide §7.4):**

- [ ] PR description: "Deltas from ticket: None substantive" does not hold. `doSort` copies instead of sorting in place, and every test sits in one `collection/` file where AC-4 names `collection/` and `data/` (RA-2).
- [x] Anchor & Echo summaries: `getValue` and `sortArray` JSDoc match their code.
- [x] `[RETROSPECTIVE]` tag: none claimed.
- [ ] Linked anchors: the AC Evidence table maps AC-2 (Store and TreeStore, both modes) to the Collection test, and has no header row, so it renders as text (RA-2).

**Findings:** Two body drifts, folded into RA-2. Separately, the review-request A2A described `findInsertIndex`, a `hasDot` flag and three per-class spec files. None of them is in the diff (`findInsertIndex` does not exist in `src`), so it has no bearing on the code.
